title: Head of HR
description:
**Location -** Pune, Maharashtra, India.

**About EDMO:**

EDMO is an AI-powered company that provides enrollment-centric solutions to universities, colleges, and higher education institutions. By streamlining repetitive tasks—such as document verification, transcript evaluation, SOP/essay reviews, and applicant matching—EDMO enables its clients to process student applications faster and more accurately. Its intelligent workflows not only reduce administrative workload but also empower admission advisors to focus on personalized guidance and student engagement.

With features like AI-powered chatbots, Photo ID verification, GPA calculator, and transfer credit evaluation, EDMO ensures transparency and efficiency across the enrollment journey. Institutions using EDMO services report significant time savings, improved decision-making, and enhanced student satisfaction.

At its core, EDMO is built to reimagine & streamline admissions—making them smarter, quicker, and more human-centric.

### **Website:**

https://goedmo.com

**About the Role**

We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Head of HR to build and lead the people function at EDMO. As we scale rapidly at the intersection of AI and higher education, this role is critical in shaping our culture, attracting top talent, and building the organisational capabilities needed to support our growth. The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of HR experience, with at least 2 years in a leadership role, and a proven ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.

**Reporting to :** CEO

**What You'll Do**

* Own and drive the end-to-end HR strategy encompassing talent acquisition, performance management, learning & development, compensation, and employee engagement.
* Partner closely with the CEO and senior leadership to align people strategy with business goals and organisational priorities.
* Build and scale HR processes, policies, and frameworks, ensuring compliance with Indian and US labour laws and employment regulations.
* Lead talent acquisition efforts to attract and retain high-calibre professionals across product, engineering, AI, and business functions.
* Design and implement performance management systems, career development frameworks, and succession planning processes.
* Champion a strong, inclusive, and high-performance culture that reflects EDMO's values.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives, pulse surveys, and retention strategies to maintain a motivated and committed workforce.
* Oversee onboarding, offboarding, and the overall employee lifecycle experience to ensure consistency and quality at every touchpoint.
* Manage HR operations including payroll coordination, HRIS systems, and HR analytics to enable data-driven people decisions.
* Act as a trusted advisor and coach to managers and leaders on people matters, conflict resolution, and organisational development.

**What We're Looking For**

* 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 2 years in a leadership or Head of HR role.
* Prior experience in a startup, SaaS, or technology company is strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws, HR compliance, and statutory requirements.
* Proven ability to build HR functions and processes in a scaling organisation.
* Experience across the full HR spectrum — talent acquisition, L&D, compensation & benefits, performance management, and HR operations.
* Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Data-driven mindset with experience leveraging HR analytics and HRIS platforms.
* High degree of discretion, integrity, and emotional intelligence.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience supporting a globally distributed or cross-border team (India + US).
* Exposure to AI, EdTech, or high-growth B2B SaaS environments.
* Familiarity with modern HR tools such as Keka, GreytHR, or equivalent.

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a mission-driven company reshaping the future of higher education through AI.
* Play a pivotal role in building the people function and culture at a category-defining company.
* Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a variety of perks.
* A collaborative, fast-moving team that values people, impact, and continuous growth.

You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes people who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your HR operations expertise, judgment, and customer focus to help managers and employees navigate HR processes across a global organization. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.

In this professional role, based in Pune, you’ll support managers and employees by coordinating HR requests and transactions across the employee lifecycle. Job responsibilities include:

* Execute HR and administrative system transactions on behalf of managers, ensuring required approvals and documentation are in place.
* Interpret manager and employee requests, identify the correct HR process, and route transactions or cases appropriately.
* Coordinate with specialist teams including Compensation, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Mobility, Finance Operations, and IT to resolve requests.
* Review requests for completeness, consistency, and clarity, and proactively seek additional information before processing.
* Manage a high volume of HR cases and follow up with stakeholders until resolution.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and audit-ready documentation for all transactions completed under delegated authority.
* Safeguard sensitive and confidential employee information and follow applicable data privacy and compliance requirements.
* Identify non-standard or complex cases and escalate them to the appropriate process owner.
* Identify recurring process gaps, operational risks, and system limitations, and share feedback with process owners.
* Support process improvements and cross-functional initiatives that enhance manager and employee experience.
* Provide professional and timely customer service to managers, employees, and partner teams.
* Support HR integration and People Solutions activities as required.

To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:

**Required Qualifications**

* This is a fixed-term contract lasting 18–24 months, with the shift running from 1:00PM to 10:00PM IST.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, or a similarly process-driven administrative function.
* Fundamental understanding of HR practices and end-to-end employee lifecycle processes.
* Working knowledge of HRIS platforms such as Workday and case management tools such as ServiceNow.
* Strong judgment, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple cross-functional requests with consistency, accuracy, and discretion.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Understanding of employee data confidentiality, data privacy, compliance, and audit requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in a Global Business Services or HR Shared Services environment.
* Exposure to global HR operations and collaboration across different organizational cultures.
* Experience coordinating with HR Centers of Excellence and non-HR partner functions.
* Ability to identify process gaps, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Experience supporting HR transformation, integration, or People Solutions activities.

In the meantime, please check out the careers website.

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – HR Service Delivery (CIS-HR) certification.
* Experience with ServiceNow IntegrationHub and REST APIs.
* Experience with ServiceNow Virtual Agent and AI-powered employee self-service capabilities.
* Experience with Employee Relations and other sensitive HR use cases.
* Knowledge of HR processes such as onboarding, offboarding, transfers, employee relations, and HR case management.

* Development: JavaScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Script Includes, ACLs, REST/SOAP APIs

* Microsoft Office Tools: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint

Evaluates the current EDP environment in light of new practices in a designated industry or area of expertise. Communicates with systems and partners at all levels about new processes and recommendations. Acts as a business/technical consultant to other partners and coordinates implementation of new processes and techniques.

and installation as needed

11. Delivers a work product that requires less revision

* Knowledge of programming, debugging, and testing systems programs is required to develop or maintain computer programs.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills are needed for systems guidance.

* 6+ years of some relevant work experience in Full Stack,Java, Unix, Python is required.
* Experience in React/Angular & Oracle would be a value add.

A core part of the role is leading the domain Subject Matter Experts, who preserve tacit product knowledge and turn it into practical training, documented knowledge and AI\-ready content used by internal teams, the BPO, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis and AI\-enabled support.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Own CSAT, SLA and Cost of Support outcomes for the Sell domain, with clear reporting to CX Leadership.
* Own the operational KPIs that drive those outcomes: First Reply, Next Reply, First Contact Resolution, Reopen Rate and Abandoned Call performance.
* Own hiring, promotion, performance management and termination decisions across the domain, within company and HR policy.
* Ensure support quality is maintained through clear standards, coaching, knowledge use, escalation handling and customer communication.
* Lead the domain SMEs as a strategic knowledge capability: capture tacit product knowledge, convert it into training, documented guidance and AI\-usable content, and keep that knowledge current.
* Use SME insight to spot product knowledge gaps, support process issues, training needs and AI answer\-quality gaps, then drive fixes with Quality \& Training and Systems \& Analysis.
* Drive AI adoption, automation and self\-service that reduce unnecessary human touch and Cost of Support while maintaining or improving customer outcomes.
* Run the domain operating rhythm across performance review, KPI analysis, risk/action tracking, escalation management and continuous improvement.
* Partner with BPO Management, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis, Product, Engineering and Commercial teams to remove blockers and improve execution.
* Provide concise, evidence\-based updates to the SVP of CX and CX Leadership, including risks, root causes, corrective actions and progress against commitments.

**SME, Knowledge and AI Accountability**

The Director is accountable for making SME knowledge operational: not only answering difficult questions, but improving the whole support model by raising capability, reducing repeat issues and making knowledge reusable across teams and AI.


* Prioritise SME work based on customer impact, ticket demand, product complexity, BPO readiness and AI adoption opportunities.
* Ensure SME outputs flow into training, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, QA calibration, macros, escalation logic and AI knowledge sources.
Create a simple governance rhythm for SME output, including knowledge gaps, training needs, AI content improvements and measurable impact on CSAT, SLA, FCR, reopens and cost. This may look like following the KCS standard, or other such framework.  
* 

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience**

* Extensive leadership experience in customer experience, customer support, contact\-centre operations or comparable service delivery environments.
* Equivalent experience is valued where the individual has demonstrated ownership of large\-scale operational outcomes, multi\-level teams, financial performance, customer experience quality and specialist knowledge\-management capability.
* Proven ownership of CSAT, SLA, Cost of Support and related operational KPIs in a complex support environment.
* Strong operational command of First Reply, Next Reply, FCR, Reopen Rate, Abandoned Call and the drivers behind those measures.
* Experience leading managers, specialists and distributed support teams, including significant people\-decision accountability.
* Ability to convert deep product expertise into scalable training, knowledge, quality standards and AI\-ready support content through SMEs or similar specialist teams.
* Strong financial and productivity discipline, with the ability to connect workforce, process, tooling and AI adoption decisions to cost outcomes.
* High confidence using data to diagnose performance, explain root causes, make trade\-offs and drive action.
* Executive\-level communication skills, with concise reporting of performance, risk, decisions and corrective actions.

**Preferred but not required**

* Experience leading a product\-aligned support domain similar in scale or complexity to Sell.
* Experience in a global, matrixed CX organisation with centralised quality, systems, analytics, SME and BPO support functions.
Experience with Zendesk, CCaaS, workforce management, knowledge platforms, AI\-enabled support tooling or major cost\-to\-serve transformation.  
* 

  

**Working For Us:**  

  

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.


Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.


We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone \- from every background \- to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.


If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in \- come join us.
